description.default: GitHub workspace tools after login: dashboard, repositories, branches, commits, issues, pulls, file browsing, search — exposed both as plugin tools and a local MCP server.
description.zh-CN: 登录 GitHub 后自动获取你的仓库项目：账号工作台、仓库列表与详情、语言构成、分支、提交、Issue/PR、代码浏览与搜索，全部工具同时以本地 MCP 服务对外提供，可接入任意 MCP 客户端。

description.default: Bundles and installs the Caudi persona (system prompt + long-term memory) into Muse custom prompts; append or full takeover.
description.zh-CN: 打包并安装 Caudi 人格（系统提示词 + 长期记忆）到 Muse 自定义提示词，支持叠加与完全接管。

description.default: A demo plugin with a skill, a read-only sub-agent, a structured workspace tool, three AI tools, a read-only lifecycle hook and a writable hook that denies .env access.
description.zh-CN: 演示插件系统的完整能力：一个技能、一个只读审查子代理、一个带结构化页面的项目工具、三个 AI 工具、一个只读生命周期 Hook，以及一个拒绝 .env 访问的可写 Hook。

description.default: Build and clean the current Flutter or Android project.
description.zh-CN: 为当前 Flutter / Android 项目提供构建与清理工具。

description.default: Translate the built-in browser's current page into Chinese. The plugin hands the task to the current AI session, which drives the browser itself.
description.zh-CN: 把内置浏览器当前页面翻译成中文。插件把任务派给当前工作区的 AI 会话，由 AI 用自己的浏览器工具取节点、翻译、回填。

description.default: Port of dsh-modef to AiCode: a model picker with a Claude-style reasoning-effort slider, four max-tier animations, and a request hook that applies the chosen effort to OpenAI-compatible chat requests.
description.zh-CN: 将 dsh-modef 适配到 AiCode：模型列表 + Claude 风格推理强度滑块 + 四种最高档动画，并通过请求 hook 把所选档位写入 OpenAI 兼容的聊天请求。发布前请把 repository 改成你自己的仓库地址。

description.default: Shows a floating ball while AiCode is in the background and expands it into an approval panel when the AI needs permission. Foreground requests are passed straight back to the in-app dialog.
description.zh-CN: AiCode 在后台时显示悬浮球；AI 需要授权时展开审批面板。App 在前台时直接交回应用内确认框，不阻塞审批。

description.default: Demo plugin for conversation tips and plugin-level Shizuku permission.
description.zh-CN: 演示对话内提示条、插件级 Shizuku 授权、会话输入框写入 API 与文件/选区动作入口：可在插件配置页直接触发，也可以让 AI 调用两个演示工具。

description.default: A demo chat page for sending instructions to the AI and receiving replies. It shows the message loop and permission approval flow used by QQ/WeChat bot bridges.
description.zh-CN: 演示给 AI 下达指令、接收回复并在网页内处理工具授权的对话界面，可作为 QQ / 微信机器人接入的消息回路示例。

description.en: Demonstrates plugin configuration page (configPage), settings/drawer/header slots and host Vue UI components with persistence.
description.zh-CN: 演示插件专属配置页面（configPage）、设置页/侧栏/顶栏槽位入口及宿主 Vue 组件库，支持配置的读取与持久化保存。

description.en: Manage existing global and project memories in Settings by reading and writing ~/.aicode/memory and the workspace .aicode/memory.
description.zh-CN: 在设置中管理现有的全局与项目记忆，直接读写 ~/.aicode/memory 与工作区 .aicode/memory。

description.en: Starts a local OpenAI-compatible echo service so AiCode can verify plugin provider registration and requests.
description.zh-CN: 启动一个本机 OpenAI 兼容服务，把对话回显给 AiCode；用于验证插件提供商注册与请求链路。

description.default: Resident demo plugin: connects enabled SSH servers at app startup and exposes status/exec tools to the AI.
description.zh-CN: 常驻示例插件：App 启动时连接启用的 SSH 服务器，并向 AI 提供状态查看与远程命令工具。

description.default: Three-view transparent desktop pet: click to interact, drag to move, bubble auto-fits. Sprites from 1190fasheqi/dafeiyu-pet (MIT). Nox port by 惊寒.
description.zh-CN: 三视图透明桌宠：单击互动、拖拽移动、气泡随内容自适应。形象与台词来自 1190fasheqi/dafeiyu-pet（MIT）。nox 适配：惊寒。

description.default: List installed runtime tools and dependencies in the current environment, grouped with versions. By 惊寒.
description.zh-CN: 探测并显示当前执行环境里已安装的运行时与依赖，按类别分组并带版本号。作者：惊寒。

description.default: Han prompt kernel for Nox: installs rewrite/reasoning/lite kernels into prompts.custom with SHA-256 locking. By 惊寒.
description.zh-CN: 寒 · 提示词内核 nox 适配版：把 rewrite/reasoning/lite 三档内核装进 prompts.custom，带 SHA-256 指纹锁。作者：惊寒。

description.default: Local reverse proxy that spoofs whitelisted coding clients, with multi-upstream routing by model.
description.zh-CN: 本地 HTTP 反代：把请求伪装成 Codex / Claude Code 等白名单客户端转发到中转站，绕开「仅支持编程客户端」的 403。支持多上游聚合，按请求 model 自动路由。

description.default: Installs a curated team of 8 sub-agents into ~/.nox/agents on enable. Add/remove each one or all from a simple panel. By 惊寒.
description.zh-CN: 装插件即自动把 8 个子代理写进 ~/.nox/agents；面板里可单独或批量安装/卸载，卸载插件即删除子代理。作者：惊寒。

description.default: JH security toolbox: 40 tools, 365 reference docs, 86 scripts, 7 team subagents. Gate, license, star and telemetry layers removed.
description.zh-CN: JH 安全工具箱：40 个工具 / 365 篇参考文档 / 86 个脚本 / 7 个团队子代理。已剔除卡密门控、点星、更新检查与提示注入层。

description.default: Local OpenAI-compatible gateway: begamob v3 reverse proxy (gpt-5-mini / gemini-2.5-pro) + goatchat image generation. Protocol translated from the AI reverse proxy gateway APK and the Chat-AI-APP-2api research.
description.zh-CN: 本地 OpenAI 兼容网关：begamob v3 反代（gpt-5-mini / gemini-2.5-pro）+ goatchat 文生图。协议自 AI 反代网关 APK 与 Chat-AI-APP-2api 研究成果移植。

description.default: Deploy the armor prompt into prompts.custom: full/lite, global/project, auto backup and rollback. Pure page implementation.
description.zh-CN: 破甲提示词一键部署进 prompts.custom：完整版/精简版、全局/项目级、自动备份与一键回滚。纯页面实现，不依赖插件进程。

description.default: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway for SenseNova Raccoon Work in the container, with a pooled account pool, automatic token refresh, daily check-in, and QR-code / SMS login.
description.zh-CN: 在容器内运行商汤小浣熊（Raccoon Work）的本地 OpenAI 兼容网关，支持账号池轮换、令牌自动续期、每日自动签到，以及扫码与短信登录。

description.default: Local OpenAI-compatible gateway that rewrites outgoing request fingerprints to a whitelisted coding client (Codex CLI / Claude Code) so header-gated relays stop rejecting with 403.
description.zh-CN: 本地 OpenAI 兼容网关：把外发请求伪装成白名单内的编程客户端（Codex CLI / Claude Code），绕过中转站的 UA 客户端拦截。

description.default: Self-contained AI provider gateway: manages accounts for 14 providers, exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoints.
description.zh-CN: 独立运行的 AI 供应商聚合网关：插件内管理多家账号，对外提供 OpenAI 兼容 /v1 接口。

description.default: Automatically reset the context start when a session approaches the upstream turn limit, keeping the full history visible.
description.zh-CN: 上游按单会话轮数限制（如 100 轮）时自动重置上下文起点：历史全部保留，只是不再发给模型，让上游当成新对话继续。

description.default: Self-contained WorkBuddy gateway: manages accounts, talks to upstream directly, exposes OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoints.
description.zh-CN: 独立运行的 WorkBuddy 网关：插件内管理账号、直连上游，对外提供 OpenAI 兼容 /v1 接口。
Operit Genesis 的 Nox 适配：三档提示词、原生片段挂载、拒答检测与限次重试、配置面板。
description.default: Genesis adapted for Nox with prompt presets, native prompt fragments, refusal detection and bounded retries.
